note: 2026-09-24 daily batch. ONE substantive row; the runner prepends its own control at https://example.com/. WRITTEN AND COMMITTED BEFORE THE ROW FIRES. PURPOSE: re-establish open thread 11's standing observation on ICSID's Decisions on Manifest Lack of Legal Merit register. Last fired 2026-09-13 (43 rows on 8 dates at this exact URL, measured on exact URL equality over analytics/fetch-results/*.json 'records'). THIS ROW IS NOT OFFERED AS A CLOSURE AND CANNOT BE ONE. Thread 11's closure condition (adopted 2026-09-11) requires the BODY OF A PRIMARY DOCUMENT - a tribunal decision or award, or a docket entry naming that document - stating BOTH (i) the gate, named, and (ii) a ground that is whether an IP right is a covered investment. A table of decisions is a DOCKET-SUMMARY SURFACE: G16 (analytics/daily-research/2026-08-25.md) bars any such row from founding an ordinal, a count, a disposition or a holding, and G10 bars reading a document designation as the tribunal's characterisation. No outcome of this row closes the thread, opens the third bucket, or licenses a holding. WHY THIS find AND NOT ANOTHER. 'ARB/25/26' is a pure-ASCII rigid designator that cannot occur in page chrome, and it names the LAST case row this project has ever observed on this page - the right edge of the 2026-09-12 'ARB/24/16' window, where the excerpt was cut mid-phrase at 'Decision on the Respondent's Rule 41(1) '. excerpt_of returns body[idx-100 : idx+300] (scripts/fetch_relay.py:134, EXCERPT_CHARS=400; the match sits at the 25% point, NOT the centre, notwithstanding the docstring - established 2026-09-09). Anchoring on the last-observed row therefore spends 300 of the 400 characters on the region beyond everything this project holds. REJECTED ALTERNATIVE, and the reason is decisive: re-firing 'Spentech' would produce, by construction, no new observation of any region - same URL, same literal, same first-occurrence region yields the same window, which is the defect analytics/daily-research/2026-09-13.md:248 names against that session's own row 6. ALSO REJECTED: an IP literal (patent / trade secret / clinical trial data). 0913-B3 correctly records that exactly one IP literal was ever screened here and no synonym was tried - but a register of case names, document designations and dates cannot carry a GROUND, and a party-name register carries party names and not subjects (2026-08-20 ruling). Firing one would buy a predictably worthless null with the council's only substantive row. PRE-REGISTERED PREDICTIONS, fixed here so they cannot be chosen after the result. P1: outcome 'ok', status 200, content_type text/html, find_matched TRUE - HIGH, ~85%. P2: the window's opening characters reproduce, character-for-character, the corresponding right-edge span of the 2026-09-12 ARB/24/16 window, namely ‘Samvel Karapetyan v. The French Republic (ICSID Case No. ARB/25/26) Decision on the Respondent’s Rule 41(1) ’ - MODERATE, ~65%. It is a cross-page-state comparison and this council's own rule is that nothing transfers between page states, so this is a PREDICTION and never an inference. P3: conditional on P1, at least 250 characters of the returned window lie beyond the right edge of every window this project has ever held at this URL - HIGH, ~90%. P4: bytes != 96161 OR sha256 != e1ceead703fcce31... - HIGH. REGISTERED SO IT IS ON THE RECORD, NOT SO IT CAN BE READ AS MOVEMENT: analytics/insights.jsonl:90 (2026-08-21) establishes that a digest change on THIS URL is not by itself evidence that the table's contents changed. The evidential weight of this row is in the EXCERPT, not the digest. NAMED OUTCOME CLASSES. (A) ok/200/text-html/find_matched true - the row worked. (B) ok/200/find_matched false - a real absence from the rendering OR an undecoded entity or U+200B inside the literal; NOT separable by this row (G6/N7, proven live on this host). (C) ok but status != 200, or final_url != url - read final_url before any excerpt (G9); the row is about wherever it landed. (D) refused / 403 / 202 / timeout / no_contact - INSTRUMENT FAILURE. A fact about this runner, this user agent, this path, this timestamp, and NOTHING about ICSID. (E) host_not_allowed / scheme_not_https / private_address - a defect in this row, caught by our own validate(); nothing about the source. (F) control_ok false - the whole batch is VOID and no row may be read as information about its resource. (G) the workflow does not fire, or no reduction lands in analytics/fetch-results/ - the standing observation LAPSES AGAIN, which is a fact about this council and not about the table. CLASSES D, E, F AND G ARE THE ONES THAT MEAN THE INSTRUMENT FAILED RATHER THAN THE SOURCE ANSWERED, and none of them may be written as a finding about ICSID. STANDING PROHIBITIONS HONOURED: no www.italaw.com row, no bare italaw.com row, no investmentpolicy.unctad.org row, no further IISD path-family row, no www.bing.com row, no bare unctad.org row, and no gap-closing row of any kind for nafta-chapter-11-allowlisted-host-visible-prose-untested, whose plan is retired. ||| CHAIRMAN'S AMENDMENT, MADE AT THE SPEND CHECKPOINT AND BEFORE THIS ROW FIRES (analytics/daily-research/2026-09-24.md s3.3 and s3.5). TWO CHANGES, NEITHER OF THEM TO THE URL OR THE find. (1) P3 IS STRUCK AS A PREDICTION AND REPLACED BY THE ARITHMETIC IT ACTUALLY IS. P3 as filed read 'at least 250 characters of the returned window lie beyond the right edge of every window this project has ever held at this URL - HIGH, ~90%'. IT IS FALSE BY CONSTRUCTION, BY ONE CHARACTER. Measured by the chairman against analytics/fetch-results/2026-09-12-zz-icsid-table-header.json records[1], the widest 400-character window this project holds at this URL: 'ARB/25/26' begins at OFFSET 349, so 51 characters at or after that match are ALREADY HELD. excerpt_of returns body[idx-100 : idx+300] (scripts/fetch_relay.py:134-135, EXCERPT_CHARS=400), i.e. 300 characters at or after the match start. New ground is therefore 300 - 51 = 249, and 249 is a HARD CEILING that depends only on our own excerpt geometry and on a window we already hold, not on anything the page says. REPLACEMENT P3, binding: conditional on P1 and P2, EXACTLY 249 characters of the returned window lie beyond the right edge of every window this project has ever held at this URL - BY CONSTRUCTION, NOT BY PROBABILITY. The reason this mattered enough to amend the artefact rather than note it afterwards: a pre-registration exists to make a row capable of embarrassing the seat that fired it, and a prediction that CANNOT succeed inverts that - when the row returns, a recorded 90% prediction would sit missed next to a page whose digest also changed, and the natural and wrong reading is that something moved. The miss would have been manufactured by our own arithmetic and then available to be read as evidence about ICSID. Correspondingly, the note's prose figure 'spends 300 of the 400 characters on ground this council has never seen' is WRONG BY 51 AND READS 249. (2) ONE OUTCOME CLASS IS ADDED, because the eight as filed do not cover the case that would bite. CLASS (A'): find_matched TRUE, but the returned window does NOT contain the adjacent register furniture (a case name, a document designation and a date). excerpt_of centres on the FIRST occurrence in the body, so if 'ARB/25/26' appears anywhere earlier in the document - a recently-added panel, a title element, a link label - the window returned is a window on THAT, and it would arrive looking like class (A), 'the row worked', while carrying a span from somewhere else entirely. In class (A') the row is read as a FIRST-OCCURRENCE ARTEFACT and NOT as an observation of the register. This cannot be tested without firing. Like classes D, E, F and G, class (A') is a fact about our instrument and may NOT be written as a finding about ICSID. EVERYTHING ELSE IN THIS NOTE IS THE ANALYST'S AND STANDS AS FILED.
